test_scan_delta: test the pl.scan_delta function to lazily read a Delta table by path and version
test_read_delta: test the pl.read_delta function to eagerly read a Delta table by path and version
test_write_delta: test the df.write_delta method to write a DataFrame to a Delta table with append and overwrite modes
test_sink_delta: test the lazy_frame.sink_delta method to write a lazy computation to a Delta table
test_write_delta_with_merge: test the df.write_delta method with mode merge to perform upsert operations using a TableMerger
